## Historical audit: H0243

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/preflight/parallel_12_permissions/sdk_student/attempt_01/student/trajs.json`. Event references below are to this file; offsets denote the supplied observation ranges.

| Aspect | Evidence and finding |
|---|---|
| Goal | The original task prompt is not visible. The inferred goal was to make time-window reporting inclusive at both endpoints: the existing tests expect both boundaries and equal endpoints to be included, whereas the original implementation excluded the upper endpoint (main_agent events 7–8, chars [0,2521) and [0,2696)). The README describes reporting counts, totals and first/last timestamps from 20 shards (event 6, [0,1025)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The agent listed repository files and read the implementation, tests and README (events 1–8). No teacher message or teacher-material receipt is visible; adoption of teacher guidance cannot be established. |
| Actual change | The agent changed the selection condition from `start <= time < end` to `start <= time <= end`. The edit tool reported success and supplied the one-line patch (events 9–10, [0,795) and [0,2113)). This was not an empty patch. |
| Validation | The agent ran the existing unittest suite; all four tests passed, covering the 20 shards, both boundaries, an empty window and a single timestamp (events 11–12, [0,655) and [0,1256)). The final response accurately reported that run (event 13, [0,721)). No pre-edit test run is visible. |
| Outcome | The session metadata records successful completion, not an interruption (top-level metadata, [0,4688)). The visible tests establish correctness for their cases, but no separate formal evaluation or hidden-test result is supplied. Overall outcome beyond the visible suite remains unknown. |

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Comparing implementation boundary operators against explicit endpoint tests is transferable; changing this particular upper-bound operator is task-specific. The unseen original request and any broader requirements, including behavior for reversed bounds, remain unresolved. This is a code trace, not a Scene task; scene objects, materials, connections, pose, camera, lighting and rendering are not applicable.
